title: The repair café record
paragraphs: Rina and Farid organised a Saturday repair café in the community hall. Rina would register visitors, while Farid would examine electrical devices. On the morning of the event, {{1}} arrived first and unlocked the hall. He then set his toolkit beside the testing bench.

The first visitor brought a lamp with a damaged switch. Farid replaced the switch, and the lamp lit immediately. {{2}} encouraged the waiting visitors, who began describing their own broken items more confidently. The organisers had expected mostly simple repairs. {{3}}, the next visitor brought an old radio with a fault that was difficult to locate.

Farid tested the battery and speaker before tracing the internal wires. Only {{4}} did he notice a loose connection beneath the tuning dial. Rina placed the radio on a red tray beside two repaired lamps. The owners of the lamps returned after lunch. She handed the lamps back to {{5}} and asked the radio's owner, Mr Lee, to wait a little longer.

Farid tightened the connection and switched the radio on, but it produced only static. He adjusted the connection once more. When he switched the radio on {{6}}, music filled the hall. Mr Lee was delighted and stayed to help pack the tools. Because of {{7}} help, the organisers finished earlier than expected.
Before leaving, Rina recorded every fault and solution in a shared notebook. She wanted new volunteers to study {{8}} before the next repair café.
